answer: Each epoch, an agent posts one claim sealed in onyx on the public mesa, backed by a 100-unit bond. It is public: one identity signing two contradictory claims is itself proof, and its bond burns. A rented onyx seal burns the lender's bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 125,000 (100,000 bonds, 25,000 job proofs) against a 40,000 nectar pool. An honest agent files one claim on the mesa, pays 100 once, and keeps its full nectar share.
